question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"and"** is a conjunction used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly. (और)

 
 
• **Example: **She bought apples and oranges from the market.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that human attitudes towards sustainability and their ignorance of environmental issues are two of the main sources of environmental pollution. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct option to fill in the blank is **'and'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Since** (जबसे): Used to indicate a point in time in the past from which something started.

 
 
• **Example:** She has been working here since 2015.
 
 
 
• **But** (लेकिन): Used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned.
 
 
• **Example:** He wanted to go for a walk, but it was raining.
 
 
 
• **Because** (क्योंकि): For the reason that; since.
 
 
• **Example:** She was late because of the traffic.
